column13:
https://www.instagram.com/Welcome to Day 1 of this 40 day bodyweight fitness program! This is a program that is friendly for anyone of any fitness level. We provide multiple options for exercises so you can do the workouts with a partner, even if you're at different fitness levels!

All you need is 20 minutes a day and some space and you will be feeling strong, fit and flexible!

This is a progressive program so every week gets more challenging than the last. 

Make sure to follow the playlist to keep your workouts on track: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLIconE7hKrWGtMc5JDFORAB486LfMa-A6

________________________________

20 for 40 Program

20 Minutes a day (Celebrating my 20th consecutive year of my own training journey!)
40 days (Celebrating my 40th birthday this year, 2026)

This is meant to be a daily program, with no breaks! If you miss a day, just jump back in from where you left off!

The program will be on a 7 day rotation, with a different focus on each day of the week.

The weekly workout schedule:

Day 1: Mobility & Strength
Day 2: Mobility & Flexibility Flow
Day 3: Bodyweight Strength
Day 4: Rest Day Mobility
Day 5: Core & Mobility
Day 6: HIIT Cardio
Day 7: Full Body Flexibility

Please don't hesitate to ask questions on any video, we priortitize replying to training related comments of our progressive program videos!
